Soysal (arXiv:2609.13351v2) proves C(d)<= (1-d)/4 for 13/20<=d<1. Exact capacity remains unknown; the 0.0095-bit certified approximation is not an exact formula.
quote: We prove that the capacity of the binary deletion channel satisfies $C(d)\le (1-d)/4$ for every $13/20\le d<1$.

correct_text: Tian (arXiv:2608.25147v1, 2026) proves the empty-set-free formulation for inclusion-poset height at most four, equivalently the usual at-least-half formulation for families containing the empty set of height at most five, and leaves the next height case unresolved. The general frequency conjecture remains open in this result.

This improves the power-of-two upper bound to O((log n)^(5/3)); the exact order remains undetermined.

correct_text: Bou-Rabee and Peres (arXiv:2608.23545v1, 2026), Theorem 1.1(i), prove almost-sure recurrence on the square lattice with clockwise rotor mechanism and independent uniform initial rotors. This settles that standard planar case and replaces the blanket no-result assertion for Z^d, d>=2. The higher-dimensional transience assertion and arbitrary other cyclic mechanisms are not settled by this theorem.
